en_us.title: Modpack Update Available
message: A new modpack version is available.
Current version: {current_version}
Latest version: {latest_version}
Update highlights:
Fixes:
[+] Fixed evolution for locked skills: they can now evolve into their corresponding Ultimate Skills without needing to be unlocked again.
[+] Fixed incorrect field references in the quest book.
[+] Fixed Milim suddenly stopping movement while attacking mobs.
[+] Fixed chat spam when the temporary Lord of Scorching Heat skill expires.
[+] Fixed enchanted backpacks being unusable in recipes for new backpacks.
[+] Fixed players remaining in Adventure Mode after teleporting out of the Spirit Labyrinth Tree dimension.
[+] Fixed other players unexpectedly reincarnating as Fallen Angels in LAN multiplayer.
[+] Fixed various minor bugs and unintended behaviors.
New Content and Language Support:
[+] Added Milim's ultimate attack: Drago Nova.
[+] Added the Leon Cromwell boss (test version).
[+] Added the Reinhard boss from Re:Zero.
[+] Added the new Ultimate Skill Samael, Lord of Poison and its corresponding crystal.
[+] Added skill evolution tree support to the built-in offline Wiki.
[+] Added new quest book content.
[+] Added a JEI/EMI addon for viewing workstations and mob taming information, with Tensura compatibility.
[+] Added Vietnamese support. The modpack now supports Chinese, English, Russian, and Vietnamese.
Gameplay Adjustments:
[+] Removed some of Milim's resistance skills.
[+] Consuming Wrath Crystals now increases proficiency in the Wrath skill.
[+] Changed Dragon Tower structure generation spacing from 1,000 to 4,000 blocks.
[+] When evolving into Velgrynd, Flame Domination, Thought Acceleration, and Spatial Manipulation are retained, while Flame Breath is consumed.
[+] Adjusted Spirit Fox – Spirit Summoning:
- Restricted taming of stronger targets: targets must be below 20% HP, and their maximum EP in their normal state must not exceed 0.5–1× the player's.
- Summon limits across the five stages are now 3/4/5/6/8, with at most one powerful summon of each type active at a time.
- Damage redirection has been reduced from 100% to 30%–50% and now requires summons to be nearby.
[+] The Humanoid Form skill now allows players to manually return to their default form.
[+] Expanded the Great Sage skill and race selection interfaces (from the greatsage mod).
[+] Adjusted Void God's ability modes:
- Soul Consumption no longer has a cooldown.
- Spacetime Domination now has a 5-second cooldown.
- Nihility Collapse now has a maximum cooldown of 5 minutes.
[+] The foxablazeultimate debug requirements command no longer requires administrator permissions.
Optimizations and Mod Updates:
[+] Improved Milim's visual effects, animations, and AI.
[+] Reduced the modpack's import package size.
[+] Updated several mods.

zh_cn.title: 发现整合包新版本
message: 检测到整合包有新版本。
当前版本：{current_version}
最新版本：{latest_version}
更新内容：
问题修复：
[+] 修复已锁定技能的进化问题：现在可以正常进化为对应究极技能，无需重新解锁。
[+] 修复任务书中的错误字段引用。
[+] 修复米莉姆 Boss 攻击怪物时突然停止移动的问题。
[+] 修复临时灼热之王到期后刷屏的问题。
[+] 修复背包附魔后无法用于合成新背包的问题。
[+] 修复玩家从精灵迷宫树维度传送离开后仍处于冒险模式的问题。
[+] 修复局域网中其他玩家无故转生为堕天使种族的问题。
[+] 修复一些小 BUG 与非预期特性。
新增内容与语言支持：
[+] 添加米莉姆 Boss 大招「龙星爆炎霸」。
[+] 添加 Boss 莱昂·克伦威尔（测试版）。
[+] 添加 Re:Zero 莱因哈鲁特 Boss。
[+] 添加新究极技能「死毒之王·萨迈尔」及对应结晶。
[+] 离线内置 Wiki 现在支持显示技能进化树。
[+] 为任务书添加一些新内容。
[+] 添加 JEI/EMI 附属，可查看工作方块与生物驯服信息，兼容 Tensura。
[+] 添加越南语支持。目前整合包支持中文、英语、俄语与越南语。
玩法调整：
[+] 移除米莉姆 Boss 的部分抗性技能。
[+] 食用愤怒结晶现在可以增加愤怒者技能的熟练度。
[+] 龙塔结构的生成间距由 1000 格调整为 4000 格。
[+] 进化维尔格琳德时，保留原有的火焰支配、思维加速与空间操纵技能，火焰吐息将被消耗。
[+] 调整灵狐「灵之召唤」机制：
- 限制越级收服：目标血量必须低于 20%，且目标常态最大 EP 不得超过玩家的 0.5～1 倍。
- 五阶段召唤上限调整为 3／4／5／6／8，同种强力召唤物同时最多存在 1 只。
- 全额替伤调整为 30%～50% 替伤，且需要召唤物在附近。
[+] 技能「人形状态」现在可以手动恢复默认形态。
[+] 丰富大贤者的技能与种族选择界面（来自 greatsage 模组）。
[+] 调整虚空之神的能力模式：
- 魂暴喰不再需要冷却。
- 时空间支配的冷却时间调整为 5 秒。
- 虚无崩坏的最高冷却时间调整为 5 分钟。
[+] foxablazeultimate debug requirements 指令不再需要管理员权限。
优化与模组更新：
[+] 优化米莉姆 Boss 的特效、动作与 AI。
[+] 优化整合包导入包大小。
[+] 更新部分模组。
请到官网或者夸克网盘下载整合包。
